content: Jesus Irae Halakisakakoati Tahi
Hatyaoseta Jesus xaneheta hatyo nalita hoka xane Judéia koa xeta hoka imahotyoa one Jordão xa. Hoka kahare haliti hohisakoahitiya ehaliya hoka aotyakihenahitiyene, aotyakijitere akereta.
Hatyaoseta haiyanai fariseunai hasakaharetene aokowihenaha hoka axahene: — Wiyaotyakisakaho hiyetaiya waiyehenaiya hatya haliti haiyanityo halakiheta? nexaha.
Hoka Jesus haxaxane kakoa ekoaxatya enomanaha: — Xoare nexa tya Moisés aotyakisa xiso? nexa.
Hoka nexaha: — Hatyaiya atyo halakihetehena haiyanityo hoka halakisakakoati baberaxa iseheta enomana hoka axikahetene, aoka Moisés — nexaha.
Hoka Jesus nexa: — Nikare Moisés aotyakisa xiso, maisa xawaiye xahekolere hoka.
Xakore hoka hetati xowaka tyotya xoalini hare kaomakehenere xowaka atyo exakere kaxairatyaka:

content.text: Hatyo hiyeta hatya ena ite kaiyanityohena hoka halakisa hanexe, hanityo xoaha hoka haiyanityo kakoa haxawalita tyaona.

content: Nikare ite hoka maisa atyoite hinamehenahitaha xini hoka haterore henahitaha atyoite.
Hatyo hiyeta maisaiya hatya haliti hatyonai exaorehitita Enore hahotyalita mohenerehare — nexa.
Hatyaoseta xane isoahenahitaha hatyako hoka exaotyakiraharenai axene hatyo wenakakoati tahi.
Hoka Jesus nexa ihiyeha: — Enaiya halakiheta haiyanityo hoka hatya ohiro kakoa tyaohitiya hoka iniyalahare atyo tyomita haiyanityo xahita.
Exahe hatya ohiroiya haiyanene halakiheta hoka hatya ena kakoa tyaoheta hoka iniyalahare tehitiya atyo tyomita — nexa ihiyeha.
Jesus Waiyexe Wenati Aoka Xoimanai Ana
Hatyo najikinita haiyaharenai kolatyaha xoimamokosenai Jesus ana, ekaokakisa hakahe ihiyeha hoka waiyexe wenati aoka enomanaha maheta. Xakore hoka exaotyakiraharenai mahokoanetyahene.

Hoka Jesus waiya nikare enawenaneha hoka maisa waiyeta ihiye hoka nexa: — Kotare xoimanai tyoa nomani, awa atyo xamahokoanetyahene. Hiyaiya, Xekohaseti Enore naliye waikohekoa atyo exe xoimairanai akereta tyaoniterenai anere — nexa.
— Aliterexe nomita xihiye: xala xamani atyoite maisa exe xoimanai akereta Enore niraene tyakekota hoka maisaiya aliyakere tyaonahitaha exema — nexa.
Hatyaoseta Jesus xakoloharetya xoimanai hoka eseriha hiye hakahe ekaokakisa hoka wenati waiyexe aoka enomanaha.
Hatya Haliti Kaoloxere Tahi

Hatyaoseta Jesus xanehitiya ene hoka hatya haliti tema tyoa hoka hakaolise kakoa exoa enahalakoa hoka axehenene: — Waiyexe Xaotyakisatiye, xoareya notyoma hoka kaxekaka nomani wenati waiyexe matyotenehare? nexa axene.
Hoka Jesus nexa: — Xoana hoka waiyexe haoka natyo? Enore taita atyo waiyexe, maisa atyo hatehitiya aka — nexa.
— Maisa hoka koxaka hiyaiya exe xaotyakiyahonai: “Awa atyo haisa, awa atyo iniyalahare hisoma ohiro kakoa, awa atyo hikaiwa, awa atyo hamaoseratya, haiminisa hexe, hityo xoaha” nitere — nexa ihiye.
— Xaotyakisatiye, noxoiminita atyo hatyo xaotyakiyahonai xema notyaonita — nexa hatyo xoimahaliti.

Nexa hoka Jesus wahakotya enomana hoka awaiyetene hoka nexa: — Exe taitehena himaomanehare: hiyane tyotya habetehena hixiyeharenai hoka maoloxaharenai ana olo hisehena. Nikare ite hisaona hoka hikaoloxahare, hikaxiyeharexe hisaona enokoa nali. Hatyaosetaite hisoheta hoka hisoa noximi — nexa Jesus ihiye.
Hatyohare hatyo haliti sema hoka kalore amaikohare hoka xaneheta, kahare kaxiyeharexe hoka.
Hatyaoseta Jesus wahakotya haxaotyakiraharenai ana hoka nehena: — Kaxiyani, howitihare atyo kaxiyeharexenai nawenane Enore koamaniya — nexa.
Exaotyakiraharenai sema iniraene hoka hakaharetyoaha. Xakore hoka Jesus nehitiya ihiyeha: — Nohinaeharenai, howitihare atyo kaoloxerenai nawenane Enore koamaniya.
Hiyaiya, howitihare atyo kaoloxere nawenane Enore koamaniya, kamelo howitihare kaxajiyakisakitere awiyahi nakoako xahehare howitini atyo.
Exaotyakiraharenai hakaharetyoaha, semaha hatyoharenai hoka hatyo kakoaha nexa kakoaha: — Nikareya hoka xalaiya kaiyakehetehena? nexaha.

Hatyaoseta Jesus wahakotya enomanaha hoka nexa: — Halitinai ana atyo hatyoharenai howitihare, xakore hoka maisa atyo Enore ana xini howitihareta. Hiyaiya, Enore ana atyo maisa xoare hare howitiharexe — nexa.
Hatyaoseta Pedro nehena Jesus hiye: — Hiyaiyehena, wisotya tyotya wahalakiharetyoa hoka hikoamaniya wisaona — nexa.

Hoka Jesus nexa: — Aliterexe nomita xihiye, xala xamani atyoite halakisa hahana, haximarenenai, hahahalonai, hanityo, hanexe, haisaninai, hawaikohera harenai, nohiyeti exahe Iraiti Waiyexe xoaha hiyeta hoka

kaxekakehitiyaite enomana. Kahalikite kaxekakehitiya enomana, ehananai, iximarenenai, enahahalonai, inityonai, enexenai, ityaninai, ewaikoheranai. Xakore hoka haiyaharenaite kirawanehenahene. Hoka haxowakehena atyoite hoka wenati waiyexe matyotenehare kaxekaka enomana — nexa.
— Kahare kalikini kalorexe tyaoniterenai atyoite hatyo xowakiya wakahare tyaohenahitaha. Nikare ite kalikini kahare wakahare tyaoniterenaite exowakehena hoka kalorexe ite tyaonaha — nexa Jesus ihiye.
Jesus Iraehitiya Hakamane, Hakaseneheta Tahi

Hatyaoseta Jesus, exaotyakiraharenai harenai xanahitaha Jerusalém xeta. Enahetaha tonita hoka exaoyakiraharenai enajikinita tonahitaha. Hoka hakaharetyoa mokahene, exahe haiyaharenai enajikinita xaneterenai mairahitaha. Hatyaoseta Jesus haware xane haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa hoka xakai ihiyeha haxaisaka tahi hoka nehena:

— Xasemehena, wiyaneta atyo Jerusalém xeta. Nalite Haliti Ityani kamatawatyakehena sacerdotenai xekohaseharenai ana, xaotyakisatyaho kakoa waiyoretere harenai ana xoaha. Hoka exaisakaite aokaha hoka hahotyalihare halitinai anaite halakisahene aisahene maheta.
Hoka hatyonaite koexahalisene, xataholisene, mokotyahene ite, exahe aisahene ite. Xakore hoka hanamaki ferakene najikinitaite kaseheta — nexa Jesus haxaotyakiraharenai hiye.
Tiago, João Xoaha Axaha Jesus
Hatyo najikinita Zebedeu ityaninai, Tiago, João xoaha, xaneha Jesus haliya hoka nexaha: — Xekohaseti, hasemehena, waxiterehare hisehena womana — nexaha.
— Xoare nisa xomana xaokita? nexa Jesus axahene.

Hoka nexaha: — Kasani kalorexe hisaohenere xowakaite, hiyane hisokehenere hokahakala waiyexe heno xowakaite, wisoka hihaliya waokowita. Hatya hifihini maniya, hatya hiwatone maniya xoaha waokita — nexaha axahene.

Hoka Jesus nexa: — Maisa atyo xawaiyorexe xaxitereharenai kakoa. Xoana waiyehenaiya xisera erakakalati akore noterehenere, exahe waiyehenaiya xikabatixatyaka nokabatixatyakihenere akereta? nexa ihiyeha (hakamane xaokaka nikareta Jesus).
Hoka nexaha: — Há, waiyehenaiya — nexaha. Hoka Jesus nexa: — Aliterexe nomita xihiye: xiseraite erakakalati akore noterehenere hiyeta, exahe xikabatixatyakaite nokabatixatyakihenere akereta — nexa.
— Hoka xisoka xaokowitere nofihini maniya, nowatoni maniya xoaha xaokowitere atyo maisa nomaniye xini. Enore atyo hatyoharenai memere moka, isá aokowihenereharenai anere — nexa.
Hatyohare 10-hare exaotyakiraharenai semaha hoka ehareha Tiago, João xoaha hiye.
Hatyo hiyeta Jesus tyotya kawisahene hahaliya makere, hoka nehena: — Xiyaiya, xekohasetinai atyo wakatita halitinai, exahe kalorexenai atyo wakatyahitene. Exe harenai atyo waiyekehalakita xomana.
Hoka maisaiya atyo nikare xisaonita. Xala xamani atyoite xinekonitare kalorexe tyaona aokowita hoka maika hahena hahinaeharenai ana.
Maika xala xamani atyo kalorexe tyaona aokowita hoka hatyo atyoite tyotya halitinai wakanehare tyaona — nexa.
— Hiyaiya, Haliti Ityani kakoita atyo tyoa hoka maisa atyo kahakaka enomana maheta xini. Haka maheta atyo tyoa, exahe waini hoka kahare halitinai iyeheta maheta — nexa ihiyeha.
Jesus Kaxoseheta Bartimeu

Hatyaoseta Jesus xane kaoka haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa wenakalati Jericó nali. Hatyaoseta xanehitiya hatyo wenakalatita haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa, exahe kahare halitinai xoaha kakoa. Hoka waiya hatya maxosehare Bartimeu nexarexe, Timeu ityani. Hatyo atyo maxosehare. Ahoti kilihi tyokita hoka olo axita haomana.
Hoka sema Jesus Nazaré yere jiyanehena hoka kawiyatya: — Jesus, Davi jikolahare, hairakoaneharehena natyo! nexa.
Hatyaoseta haiyaharenai mahokoanetya iniraene, mema xoaha tyaona aokaha, xakore hoka exahehare kawiyahitiya: — Davi jikolahare, hairakoaneharehena natyo! nexa.
Hatyaoseta Jesus tityoa hoka nexa: — Xakawihena maxosehare ali — nexa. Hatyaoseta kawihenahene hoka nexaha: — Hihalaharehenaira! Hatityoahetehena. Hiyaiya, kawijita atyo hiso — nexaha.
Hatyaoseta Bartimeu xawatya haihiri hoka ihalahare tityoaheta hoka xane Jesus haliya.
— Xoare notyoma homana haokita? nexa Jesus axene. — Xaotyakisatiye! kasani nowaiyakatyareheta naokowita! nexa.
— Hiyanehetehena, kalikini atyo hawaiyeheta hityakekone hiyeta — nexa Jesus ihiye. Nexa hoka hatyaoseta Bartimeu waiyakahetehena rotita hoka Jesus xema xane ahoti aho.
